load_custom_module_instance: load a Python module instance from a dotted path string like 'module.submodule.ClassName'
load_instance_from_s3: load a custom logger instance from an S3 URL with format 's3://bucket/path/to/module.instance_name'
load_instance_from_gcs: load a custom logger instance from a GCS URL with format 'gcs://bucket/path/to/module.instance_name'
download_gcs_file: download a Python file from Google Cloud Storage to a local path asynchronously
validate_custom_validator: validate that a custom validator function is annotated to return Literal[True]
